# Taqueria Hacienda Tapatia

> Taqueria in San Antonio, Texas. Breakfast, lunch and dinner under the green sign on North I-35. Red salsa made here, and good tea.

- Phone: (210) 599-3600
- Address: 6402 N Interstate 35, San Antonio, TX 78218
- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Breakfast; Homemade salsas; Plates for the table
- Rating: 4.2 from 2060 Google reviews
